archimate:ApplicationService.name: Interoperability and Exchange Service
archimate:ApplicationService.documentation:
An Interoperability & Exchange Service is a dedicated software middleware module that enables disparate healthcare applications and IT environments to communicate, interpret, and securely share data using standardized transmission protocols.
Its purpose is to dismantle information silos across distinct medical entities, ensuring that vital clinical data flows seamlessly between different systems without requiring complex manual translations.
An emergency department uses this service to instantly pull a conscious patient's prescription history from an external pharmacy software network using secure HL7 FHIR (Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources) data standards.
